title: Contact
subtitle: Interested in frontend roles, contract work, or technical collaboration? I'd love to hear from you.

form.successMessage: Thanks for reaching out. Your message has been recorded locally — connect a form backend (e.g. Formspree) to deliver it to zafth98@gmail.com.

faq.question: What kind of roles are you looking for?
faq.answer: Senior frontend and lead-leaning IC roles focused on React, Next.js, design systems, performance, and real-time product surfaces. Open to any industry or business domain — healthcare and fintech are strengths, not limits.

faq.question: Are you open to remote work or relocating?
faq.answer: Yes. I can work remotely for teams anywhere, and I’m especially interested in opportunities in the Netherlands (remote, hybrid, or on-site). I’ve already delivered successfully for distributed and international clients.

faq.question: Can I download your résumé?
faq.answer: Yes — use the résumé link on the homepage or contact page to download the latest PDF.
